core_claim: Machine intelligence is represented by verified capability-resource developmental profiles over declared ecology and development protocols; known architectures are resource-bounded realizations/factorizations of task-relative semantic developmental states.

obligation.rule: No intelligence claim is representation-independent of all task/evaluation/resource/development choices.

developmental_situation.reason: External history alone need not determine future behavior/development when optimizer, memory, random-state, posterior, replay-buffer or structural state differs.
developmental_situation.hidden_environment_rule: Unobserved environment state is not free machine information; it is integrated over the registered environment law unless legally observed.

semantic_state.name: semantic_developmental_sufficient_state
semantic_state.definition: Equivalence class of developmental situations inducing identical registered future semantic-trace distributions under every admissible future intervention/programme and fixed development protocol.
semantic_state.not_claimed: physical or uniquely smallest cognitive atom
semantic_state.computability_boundary: The exact semantic quotient need not be constructible; practical systems may use approximate/belief/predictive-state representations.

meaning.Theta: mutable parameters, rules, memory, beliefs or configuration
meaning.kappa: semantics/compiler map into the registered semantic state/obligation

morphology.separation_rule: Two morphologies may be semantically equivalent but resource-non-equivalent; resource receipts belong to realization/frontier comparison unless explicitly promoted into the semantic obligation.

intelligence_profile.reachable_set: A_M(E|d,D) = {(Q,B): reachable under morphology M and registered development protocol D from situation d}
intelligence_profile.scalarization_rule: A scalar score requires a prospectively declared ecology measure and capability/resource utility.

generality.reason: different deployed systems can have identical intelligence profiles

development_levels.K1: cognition/search capital: inherited developmental state changes future cognition-generation before fresh target success and lowers verified burden
development_levels.K2: developmental capital: inherited state lowers the burden of acquiring new K1
development_levels.K3: improvement/morphogenesis capital: inherited state improves the process that discovers/improves future cognition or morphologies
